tests.name: security.tls.v1_0_client
tests.test_description: Device uses TLS with connection to an external service on port 443 (or any other port which could be running the webserver-HTTPS)
tests.expected_behavior: The packet indicates a TLS connection with at least TLS 1.0 and support
recommendations: Ensure any URLs connected to are secure (https)

tests.name: security.tls.v1_2_server
tests.test_description: Check the device web server TLS 1.2 and the certificate is valid
tests.expected_behavior: TLS 1.2 certificate is issued to the web browser client when accessed
recommendations: Enable TLS 1.2 support in the web server configuration
Sign the certificate used by the web server

recommendations: Ensure any URLs connected to are secure (https)

tests.name: security.http.server
tests.test_description: Automated RFC 9110 compliance validation of the device's HTTP/HTTPS server
tests.expected_behavior: The server responds with status 200 OK for both GET and HEAD methods with an empty HEAD body and matching critical headers, returns 405 or 501 for unsupported methods
recommendations: Implement the GET and HEAD methods on the web server
Ensure that the HEAD response is empty
Ensure that the GET and HEAD response headers (Content-Length, Content-Type) match
Ensure that unsupported requests return a 405 or 501 status code
